text: 2026-08-03 checkpoint: the source-blind architecture proposal has been converted into source-grounded Mote work. Structural schema/fingerprint propagation, stable HRF basis identity, typed semantic hypotheses, S07/S10/S16 scenarios, an independent R design receipt, and cross-solver rank comparisons are implemented and pass the full JVM/JS first-level gate. The work is intentionally not declared complete: Phase 1 and later policy phases remain open, with a documented default-precision convolution parity gap and pending alias/heterogeneous-HRF/multirun/WLS breadth.
